findings.claim: the Hermes smoke check passed even when the classifier ran for Hermes
the r3 cloud-suffix scan was narrower than the row

verdict.text: f1 is fixed.
The smoke now counts `decisions` entries in `extra_fields.routing_metadata.calls`.
The router check fails when a router chat makes none, and the Hermes check fails when a Hermes chat makes one.
The stub tests prove both directions.
The fix broke nothing nearby.
f2 was also fixed, though it was not sent back.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: pre_commit pass, cli_tests pass, rows r1-r4 pass, "stamp green: 73b23952fdd4...f659".
`uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_bifrost_router.py -q`: 9 passed.
Response shape: spike 1 stdout shows `extra_fields.routing_metadata.calls[]` with `request_type: "decisions"` and `routing_info.model` side by side.
That matches `chat_extra` and `classifier_calls`.
Vacuity: the Hermes "no call" check could pass if the path were wrong.
But the router check in the same run requires a non-zero count on that same path, so a wrong path fails the smoke instead of passing it.
Stub tests: the router parametrization covers routed, not-routed and no classifier call.
The Hermes one covers kept, rerouted and classifier-called.
Each failing case expects SmokeFailure, so a check that dropped the call-count assertion would fail the test.
ADR 0029 line 63-65 now says the key-refuses claim is not measured.
`_assert_no_cloud_suffix` scans the decision model, every rule target, every provider key's `models`, and every `bifrost_virtual_key` block's `allowed_models`, with a floor of more than 10 names.
f1: resolved in `assert_router_routes_by_tier` and `assert_hermes_not_rerouted` (scripts/bifrost_smoke.py), with the `test_smoke_router_check` and `test_smoke_hermes_check` parametrizations.
f2: resolved in `_assert_no_cloud_suffix`, called from `test_router_key`.
If Bifrost ever sends `"routing_metadata": null`, `classifier_calls` raises AttributeError instead of SmokeFailure.
The smoke still exits non-zero with a traceback rather than passing, and no spike showed a null, so this asks for nothing.
